notes.title: LOONEWS 7 | Erogoddess: Mirage Released & 69 Summon Succubus Update
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/d41f9d1a2127f3e3b333eae8217c72c640f19c1a.png

Dear friends Erogoddess: Mirage is now available! Dating simulator with feminized Egyptian gods. Ra, Anubis, Seth, Osiris, Horus and other gods are waiting for you. Discover new gods by spinning the wheel of fortune. In the near future we will give away 10 keys to the game in our Discord!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/be825650ddb0b013874751f2ca38727bd9afe884.gif

Also for 69 Summon Succubus an update has been released! The cute wolf Lucia has been added to the game.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/655ea170a027e0d7adc70659f89072959de6e43b.png

notes.title: [DevLog#2] Goblin Dungeons
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/75eab22b33380c526a3a43e359339e7cb95d4b7e.jpg
Goblin Dungeons Page
I finally decided to switch to Spine Animations and have been working on sex scenes lately. Along the way, I developed new tools for convenient work.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/f5c7a57a91dd7874d3e68486915f2c00a0641b2b.gif

In my opinion, Spine gives an amazing result in smoothness and naturalness. I am very pleased with what I get, and the difficulties I encounter do not scare me.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/357160c2228990d59e88f775d1df7a27b6244879.gif

Sex scenes will be opened after the defeat. Whoever defeated you will possess the heroine. Further development of the scene can be opened for the local currency - goblin members. I will try to make a unique scene for each enemy with the possibility of development.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/b24e7c34ff197fc12d3a7cc78feb9a53e8f53d88.gif

More details in my Discord
